shortDescription: Create or destroy a IONOS CLOUD NetworkLoadbalancer.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: The ID or name of the datacenter.

options.name: ips
options.description: Collection of the Network Load Balancer IP addresses. (Inbound and outbound) IPs of the listenerLan must be customer-reserved IPs for public Load Balancers, and private IPs for private Load Balancers.

options.name: lb_private_ips
options.description: Collection of private IP addresses with subnet mask of the Network Load Balancer. IPs must contain a valid subnet mask. If no IP is provided, the system will generate an IP with /24 subnet.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Network Load Balancer.

options.name: network_load_balancer
options.description: The ID or name of the Network Loadbalancer.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: target_lan
options.description: ID of the balanced private target LAN (outbound).

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
